name: postgres18-schema-dump
sql: SELECT t.a, t.b, parent.a AS start_span, parent.b AS end_span FROM pg18_constraints.t CROSS JOIN pg18_constraints.parent

name: omitted-temporal-reference
sql: CREATE TABLE pg18_constraints.implicit_parent (a daterange, b daterange, FOREIGN KEY (a, PERIOD b) REFERENCES pg18_constraints.parent)

name: period-column-type
sql: CREATE TABLE pg18_constraints.invalid_period (a integer, PRIMARY KEY (a WITHOUT OVERLAPS))

name: no-temporal-key
sql: CREATE TABLE pg18_constraints.invalid_reference (a daterange, b daterange, FOREIGN KEY (a, PERIOD b) REFERENCES pg18_constraints.t(a, PERIOD b))

name: period-mismatch
sql: CREATE TABLE pg18_constraints.period_mismatch (a daterange, b daterange, FOREIGN KEY (a, PERIOD b) REFERENCES pg18_constraints.parent (a, b))

name: period-action
sql: CREATE TABLE pg18_constraints.period_action (a daterange, b daterange, FOREIGN KEY (a, PERIOD b) REFERENCES pg18_constraints.parent ON DELETE CASCADE)
